original_request: Add a new Step 2.5 PROCESSING between Step 2 (Downbeat/Beat Grid) and Step 3 (Slice) in WavePreviewPage with Gate, Expansion, Compression, Limiting, and EQ effects.
user_modifications: PARALLEL COMPRESSION: Add dry/wet blend knob to the compressor for NY compression style
PRESET SAVE/LOAD: Save/load effect presets (Clean Drums, Punchy Kicks, etc.) in user data folder
LIVE WAVEFORM VISUALIZATION: Processing changes visible in REAL-TIME on waveform display
THRESHOLD LINES ON WAVEFORM: Draggable horizontal lines for Gate, Expander, Compressor thresholds
6-BAND EQ: Low (80Hz), Low-Mid (250Hz), Mid (1kHz), Mid-High (3kHz), High (8kHz), Air (12kHz+)

specification.summary: Step 2.5 PROCESSING - Pre-Slice Audio Effects Chain
specification.description: Insert a new workflow step between Tempo (Step 2) and Slice (Step 3) that allows users to apply dynamics and EQ processing to the selected audio region BEFORE slicing. Real-time visual feedback via waveform updates and draggable threshold lines.
deliverables: New step pill button: '2.5 PROCESS' in step navigation tabs
Processing control panel with 5 effect sections
Backend processing logic to apply effects to audio buffer
Live waveform visualization with real-time updates
Draggable threshold lines on waveform for Gate/Expander/Compressor
Preset save/load system for effect settings
Processed audio buffer passed to Step 3 for slicing

gate.description: Noise Gate - silences audio below threshold

expander.description: Dynamic Expander - reduces gain below threshold

compressor.description: Dynamic Compressor with parallel/dry-wet blend (NY compression)

audio_flow: Step 2.5 (PROCESSING) - User configures effects, sees real-time waveform updates
Step 3 (SLICE) - Slicing uses PROCESSED audio buffer

ui_requirements.effect_modules: Horizontal strip of 5 effect modules in control panel
ui_requirements.waveform_overlay: Draggable threshold lines for Gate, Expander, Compressor
ui_requirements.live_preview: Waveform redraws in real-time as parameters change

thread_safety.ui_update: AsyncUpdater for safe UI thread callbacks
thread_safety.real_time_preview: Affects playback in real-time during preview

presets.storage_location: User data folder (JUCE getApplicationDir or similar)
presets.user_presets: Allow user to save custom presets

assumptions: Processing is applied to the entire selected region (not per-slice)
Processing is destructive to workflow buffer (original file untouched)
User can preview processed audio in real-time during playback
Processing order is fixed: Gate -> Expander -> Compressor -> Limiter -> EQ
Each effect can be individually bypassed via toggle
Step 2.5 is optional - user can skip directly to Step 3 if no processing needed
